title: Core Utility Functions
summary: This module provides fundamental utility classes and functions for caching, object serialization, system information, iterable manipulation, HTML parsing, Pydantic model enhancements, and version consistency checks.

nodes.label: In-Memory Cache
nodes.title: In-Memory Cache
nodes.description: A cache implementation that stores key-value pairs in memory, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous lookup, update, and clear operations. It can be configured with a maximum size to manage memory usage.

nodes.label: Serializable Base Class
nodes.title: Serializable Base Class
nodes.description: Provides a base class for objects that can be serialized to JSON. It defines methods for determining serializability, getting a unique namespace, handling secrets, and including additional attributes for serialization.

nodes.label: Print System Information
nodes.title: Print System Information
nodes.description: Gathers and prints detailed system and package information, including OS, Python version, and versions of LangChain-related packages, useful for debugging and environment analysis.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Tee Iterator
nodes.title: Asynchronous Tee Iterator
nodes.description: Splits a single asynchronous iterable into multiple independent asynchronous iterators, allowing each child iterator to consume items at its own pace while buffering shared items.

nodes.label: Extract HTML Sub-Links
nodes.title: Extract HTML Sub-Links
nodes.description: Parses an HTML string to extract all links, converts them to absolute paths, and can filter them based on a base URL, regex patterns, and exclusion prefixes.

nodes.label: Synchronous Tee Iterator
nodes.title: Synchronous Tee Iterator
nodes.description: Splits a single synchronous iterable into multiple independent synchronous iterators, allowing each child iterator to consume items at its own pace while buffering shared items.

nodes.label: Pydantic Model Wrapper
nodes.title: Pydantic Model Wrapper
nodes.description: A utility that modifies Pydantic model initialization logic, handling default values, aliases, and population by field name before the model is validated.

nodes.label: Get Pydantic Major Version
nodes.title: Get Pydantic Major Version
nodes.description: A deprecated utility function to retrieve the major version number of the Pydantic library. It is recommended to use `PYDANTIC_VERSION.major` directly.

nodes.label: Argument Validation Wrapper
nodes.title: Argument Validation Wrapper
nodes.description: A utility that ensures exactly one argument within specified groups is provided and not `None`, raising a `ValueError` if validation fails.

nodes.label: Core Library Version Check
nodes.title: Core Library Version Check
nodes.description: A script that validates version consistency between `pyproject.toml` and `langchain_core/version.py` for the core library.

nodes.label: Langchain V1 Version Check
nodes.title: Langchain V1 Version Check
nodes.description: A script that validates version consistency between `pyproject.toml` and `langchain/__init__.py` for the `langchain_v1` library.

groups.label: Data Management
groups.title: Data Management
groups.description: Handles in-memory caching and provides a base for serializing objects to JSON, including secret management.

groups.label: System & Versioning
groups.title: System & Versioning
groups.description: Provides tools for inspecting the system environment, listing installed packages, and ensuring version consistency across different parts of the library.

groups.label: Iteration & Streaming
groups.title: Iteration & Streaming
groups.description: Offers utilities for splitting iterables into multiple independent iterators, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous data streams.

groups.label: Pydantic & Validation
groups.title: Pydantic & Validation
groups.description: Contains utilities for enhancing Pydantic model behavior, such as handling initialization logic and validating argument groups.

groups.label: Web & HTML Processing
groups.title: Web & HTML Processing
groups.description: Includes functions for parsing HTML content to extract and process links, with options for filtering and path conversion.
